# stackchan-mcp-mod

> A MOD for the Stack-chan desk robot (M5StackChan CoreS3, stack-chan firmware v1.1.0) that serves MCP tools over
> HTTP, so an AI assistant can take photos, listen to the room, speak, move the robot's head, drive its LEDs and
> react to touch. Written in JavaScript for the Moddable XS engine; it installs to a flash partition without
> rebuilding the firmware.

Two things shape almost every decision in this codebase, and an agent that misses them will write code that bricks
a session: an uncaught exception or unhandled promise rejection reboots the device, and an oversized response takes the HTTP
server down rather than merely failing (~28 KB bodies are known good, ~56 KB is fatal). Changes cannot be verified without the physical
robot — a passing build proves only that the JavaScript compiles.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the constraints, the layout, the conventions, and the settled questions not worth
  re-litigating. Read this before changing code.
- [README.md](README.md): what the project is, the tool list, how to build, install and configure it.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): how the modules fit together, the boot sequence, and how a request
  flows from HTTP to a tool handler.

## Reference

- [docs/tool-reference.md](docs/tool-reference.md): every tool with its arguments, generated from a live robot by
  `scripts/dump-tools.sh`.
- [docs/device-notes.md](docs/device-notes.md): the empirical record — measured device limits, firmware bugs found
  along the way, and the approaches that did not work. Consult it before assuming a surprising behaviour is a bug
  in this code.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): what installing this exposes, the capture policy, and the hardening of the
  unauthenticated request path.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): what a change needs before it can be proposed.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.

## Optional

- [stackchan-robot/skills/stackchan-robot/SKILL.md](stackchan-robot/skills/stackchan-robot/SKILL.md): an operator
  skill for assistants driving the robot — safe operation, recovery, and how to report physical outcomes honestly.
  Packaged as a Claude Code plugin via `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. Not needed to modify the code.
